y = all_data["outcome"].to_numpy(float)
beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
resid = y - X @ beta
n_obs, p = X.shape
sigma2 = float((resid @ resid) / (n_obs - p))
XtX_inv = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)

print("\ncombined residual sd:", round(np.sqrt(sigma2), 4))

# print interpretable coefficients by line
base = beta[:3]
print("\nQuadratic coefficients by line [intercept, linear, quad]:")
print("1", np.round(base, 4))
offset = 3
for L in range(2, 6):
    print(L, np.round(base + beta[offset:offset+3], 4))
    offset += 3

code = f'''
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def model(regime, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    line = int(regime.config.get("line"))
    d = float(regime.config.get("driver"))

    beta = np.array({beta.tolist()}, dtype=float)
    XtX_inv = np.array({XtX_inv.tolist()}, dtype=float)
    sigma2 = float({sigma2})

    x = [1.0, d, d*d]
    for L in range(2, 6):
        x += [1.0 if line == L else 0.0, d if line == L else 0.0, d*d if line == L else 0.0]
    x = np.array(x, dtype=float)

    # Draw coefficients to reflect estimation uncertainty, then add batch noise.
    beta_draw = rng.multivariate_normal(beta, sigma2 * XtX_inv)
    mu = float(x @ beta_draw)
    outcome = rng.normal(mu, np.sqrt(sigma2), size=n)
    return pd.DataFrame({{"outcome": outcome}})
'''
working_model = code
res = env.submit(code)
print("\nsubmit accepted:", res.accepted)
print("submit error:", getattr(res, "error", None))
